entities.name: Anterior radial head
observations: An anterior radial-head dysfunction limits supination because the radial head cannot translate posteriorly during supination; this matches the reported objective motion restriction. Evidence also notes that lateral tenderness alone is not specific.

entities.name: Radial head translation
observations: Biomechanical evidence reports a posterior radial-head location in supination and an anterior location in pronation; physiologic contact shifts anterior-to-posterior during rotation.

entities.name: Lateral epicondylitis
observations: A competing diagnosis causing lateral epicondyle tenderness in tennis players, commonly reproduced by resisted wrist extension or gripping; it does not by itself establish a radial-head positional dysfunction.

entities.name: Proximal radioulnar joint dysfunction
observations: Joint-level dysfunction can impair pronation-supination and radial-head translation; the more specific positional diagnosis in this scenario is anterior radial head.

entities.name: PMID:16321461
observations: Biomechanical study cited in the search evidence reports posterior radial-head location during supination and anterior location during pronation.

entities.name: PMID:25542245
observations: Biomechanical study cited in the search evidence describes physiologic anterior-to-posterior radial-head contact shift during forearm rotation.

entities.name: PMID:25424625
observations: 2014 Journal of Ovarian Research study titled “Anti-IGF-1R monoclonal antibody inhibits the carcinogenicity activity of acquired trastuzumab-resistant SKOV3.”

entities.name: LMAb1
observations: Novel anti-IGF-1R monoclonal antibody tested against acquired trastuzumab-resistant SKOV3-T cells.

entities.name: SKOV3-T
observations: Acquired trastuzumab-resistant derivative of HER2-overexpressing human SKOV3 cells generated by continuous culture in 10 μg/mL trastuzumab for 8 months; characterized by lower HER2 and higher IGF-1R expression.

entities.name: LMAb1 inhibits SKOV3-T
observations: In SKOV3-T, LMAb1 inhibited growth/proliferation, migration, colony formation, and in-vivo xenograft carcinogenicity; LMAb1 plus trastuzumab produced smaller tumors and longer mouse survival. Proposed mechanism involved IGF-1R and downstream MAPK/AKT signaling inhibition.

entities.name: LMAb1 endpoint scope
observations: The available record reports proliferation or viability, migration, colony formation, xenograft tumor size, and mouse survival; it does not explicitly identify apoptosis as a principal LMAb1 endpoint.
